The calculator has an area selector; jurisdiction and Fee Index pages show the range across areas. (2) Proration: cities that publish a per-dwelling base (not an ADU fee) now prorate as (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x base under Gov. Code §66311.5(c)(1)(B), with a new primary-dwelling input in the calculator (1,600 sq ft default, labeled as an assumption). Flat lines whose derivation is genuinely unpublished (including Hayward, a city-published ADU flat fee) stay marked 'conversion not published yet' and are never guessed. (3) Hayward park fee corrected $3,823 to $3,812 per the Adopted FY2025-26 Master Fee Schedule (eff. 7/1/2025); no FY2026-27 schedule was found as of 24 Oct 2026.
